### Historical audit: S0178

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r2/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`. All citations below refer to this file and the supplied character ranges.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Line 1, `model_request`, chars [0,9034) | The **intended task** was to reconstruct a 512 × 341 indoor photograph as an editable SceneAct/Blender scene, with separate architecture, furniture and object meshes, matching viewpoint, placement, colors and materials. The photograph is referenced by path but its pixels are not included in this audit, so the particular scene and its objects cannot be independently described. |
| Line 1, `model_request`, chars [0,9034) | The student was instructed to make a compact initial program, inspect a render, and correct major discrepancies. These are instructions, not evidence that any build or review occurred. The prompt also supplied procedural guidance; it is not evidence of a teacher intervention or its adoption. |
| Line 2, `codex_session`, chars [0,2635) | One fresh student CLI session was attempted with the image staged, read-only sandbox, no observable tool calls and exit code 1 after about 19 seconds. Actual model and underlying model-round count are unknown. |
| Lines 3–4, `model_error` and `scene_error`, chars [0,551) and [0,1614) respectively | The runtime reported that the student exited 1, with a traceback from `runtime.ask` through the wrapper. It points to a stderr log whose contents are not supplied. This establishes a **technical interruption**, not its underlying cause. |

**Changes and validation.** No student program, scene modification, successful build, render, image comparison or submitted result is visible. Consequently, there is no evidence to assess multiple objects, material or texture fidelity, part connections, object pose, camera, lighting or rendering quality. The request for those features is not proof of their implementation. No autonomous exploration or correction is visible beyond the attempted session; zero tool calls does not establish what internal reasoning occurred.

**Teacher and outcome.** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution, input to the student, or adoption is visible. This is a student trajectory, not a teacher-only trace. The observed outcome is interruption before a visible reconstruction; formal geometric correctness and overall task outcome remain unknown. It is not evidence of an empty patch or an algorithmic reconstruction failure.

**Transferable lesson and uncertainty.** An exited model session without a render cannot support a visual-quality judgment; the unavailable stderr would be needed to investigate the immediate failure. Whether a retry would succeed, and what scene-specific corrections would be needed, remain unresolved hypotheses.
